name: Mintlify Admin MCP
description: Lets Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor edit, restructure and publish Mintlify docs sites through pull requests, and manage settings and analytics via hosted MCP.

skills.name: Edit Docs Pages
skills.description: Reads, searches and edits MDX pages on a branch, landing changes as unpublished edits or as a pull request.

skills.name: Restructure Navigation
skills.description: Adds, renames, moves and deletes pages, groups, tabs and versions in the docs navigation tree and reports invalid states.

skills.name: Publish Changes
skills.description: Commits pending changes or merges a branch's pull request, then checks whether the deploy is live on the docs site.

skills.name: Handle Comments and Reviews
skills.description: Reads, adds and resolves editor comments, suggests tracked edits, and requests or approves reviews before publishing.

skills.name: Query Docs Analytics
skills.description: Reads page views, search quality, feedback and assistant chat reports, or runs read-only SQL on the site's analytics.
